subject: JoyAI-Talker / Joy-Duplex

primary_sources.title: JoyAI-Talker: Full-Duplex Speech Interactive Large Model Built for Empathetic Voice Agents

source_supported_findings.architecture: JoyAI-Talker explicitly separates conversational state coordination, cognitive planning, and expressive speech generation into Duplex, Thinker, and Talker boundaries.
source_supported_findings.duplex_controller: Joy-Duplex is a decoupled state-driven plug-and-play gating layer. Its streaming encoder consumes non-overlapping 160 ms audio chunks; the decoder is a 1.7B decoder-only model that interleaves incremental text with interaction-state tokens.
source_supported_findings.gating: The downstream speech dialogue model remains gated until an explicit accept state is emitted; reject suppresses activation for off-target/background speech.
source_supported_findings.thinker_talker_split: The Thinker determines response content/communicative intent while the Talker specializes in speaker-consistent expressive low-latency speech generation.
source_supported_findings.talker_control: The Talker uses global and local natural-language instructions. Speaker identity is fixed after speaker-specific SFT while utterance-level emotion, speaking rate/rhythm, breathiness and other expressive attributes remain dynamically controllable.
source_supported_findings.talker_training_language_surface: The paper states that Talker foundation training uses a multilingual corpus, but the checked primary sources do not enumerate German or provide a German-specific evaluation.
source_supported_findings.agent_surface: The paper reports speech tool-calling evaluation and configures JoyAI-Talker at 48B total parameters with 3B active parameters for the reported tool-calling comparison.
source_supported_findings.known_limitation: The paper explicitly notes that a fully end-to-end dual-stream architecture may obtain lower turn-taking latency and stronger concurrent input/output synchronization than the modular Joy-Duplex approach.

mapping.Joy-Duplex partial/complete/backchannel/: timestamped VoiceActionCandidate / VoiceIntent candidate lane before canonical GWT arbitration
mapping.Thinker: provider-neutral cognition plane; local Qwen-class path or optional Claude-augmented organ without identity/state/effect authority
mapping.localized paralinguistic events: typed bounded vocal-event candidates such as laughter/sigh/backchannel, never world facts

frankenstein_transfer_hypothesis.authority_boundary: Model state/action output remains candidate cognition. It may not bypass VoiceIntent/GWT arbitration, UnifiedDB authority, or EffectGate/EffectJournal.

counterhypothesis: The modular gating layer may reduce false triggers but add semantic serialization and scheduling latency; a native time-aligned full-duplex system could outperform it on overlap while preserving adequate cognition. The architecture donor must therefore be tested as a benchmarkable interaction-control layer rather than adopted on elegance alone.
